prompts.W2: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one standalone full-bleed iPad landscape wallpaper, target aspect ratio 1.45:1 width/height (for example 1740x1200), landscape, not panoramic. Original scene inspired by the tender letter-writing, memory and healing themes of Violet Evergarden, not a canon scene. Painterly semi-realistic fantasy concept art with controlled digital oil/gouache brushwork, natural anatomy, subtle material texture, luminous atmospheric depth and rich art-book quality. An adult traveling seamstress with a chestnut braid sits beneath a flowering railway-station canopy. She carefully stitches a cream letter pocket into the exposed inner lining of her own plum velvet traveling coat resting across her lap. A small open sewing case sits beside her. Her bare hands, needle, thread and fabric show one clear physically plausible sewing action. Place her slightly left of center, medium-wide view keeping expression and needlework legible. Branches and pale spring blossoms frame the upper scene; empty platform and curving railway tracks open into a flowering orchard on the right. Dusty rose, charcoal, cream, rich plum; warm low sunset under cool clouds. Velvet nap catches golden light along the repaired seam. A few drifting petals. Quiet hope and tenderness. Deliberate luminous lighting and nuanced painted surfaces, not photography, not flat anime/cel shading. Artwork across the whole frame with a small crop margin around face, hands and sewing case. Exactly one adult woman, no other people. No readable text, UI, logos, watermark, border, device frame, panels or montage.
prompts.W3: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one standalone full-bleed iPad landscape wallpaper, target aspect ratio 1.45:1 width/height (for example 1740x1200), landscape, not panoramic. Original scene inspired by Violet Evergarden's themes of letters, memory and healing, not a canon event. Painterly semi-realistic fantasy concept art with natural human proportions, controlled digital oil/gouache brushwork, art-book quality, nuanced materials and luminous layered mountain atmosphere. One adult mountain postal keeper with silver-streaked dark hair stands at the open entrance of a weathered mountaintop observatory. Indigo wool cloak and weathered leather gloves. She has just opened a long-delayed cream envelope with softened edges; cracked copper-red sealing wax remains on the lifted flap. She gazes down at it with quiet relief. Envelope visually legible as the focal prop but without readable writing. Medium-wide composition places her on the right third with curved telescope dome and a glimpse of the instrument behind her. Across the left and middle distance, a newly thawing mountain road winds between snowbanks toward a vast sea of clouds. First dawn lights her cheek, glove edges, sealing wax and snowy ridges. Ultramarine shadows, copper dawn, snow-white highlights; visible wool fibers and creased glove leather. Full-frame artwork with crop margin around head and hands; expansive but not excessively wide. Exactly one adult woman. Plausible hands holding the envelope. No text, UI, logo, watermark, border, device frame, panels, montage, photorealism or flat anime/cel shading.
prompts.L2: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one standalone full-bleed iPad landscape wallpaper, target aspect ratio 1.45:1 width/height (for example 1740x1200), landscape, not panoramic. Original invented scene inspired by the letters, travel and healing themes of Violet Evergarden, not a canon location. Empty mountain railway station during the first spring thaw, painterly semi-realistic fantasy concept art with controlled digital oil/gouache brushwork, nuanced weathered materials, luminous soft light, rich art-book quality and atmospheric depth. One sealed worn leather mailbag with tarnished brass buckles rests on a wooden platform bench in the near middle ground; closed flap and fastened straps clearly visible. A shallow ribbon of snowmelt glints beneath the platform edge. Pale pink plum blossoms arch above the bench; remaining snow on shaded ground and distant peaks. Bench and bag near left third, modest station building behind them, coherent railway tracks curving through right side into a broad mountain valley. Platform lamp provides a slender vertical accent. Slate blue, pale pink, amber; late-afternoon sunlight breaks beneath retreating clouds and grazes creased leather. Quiet anticipation after a long winter. Coherent station architecture and rail spacing; full-frame artwork with small crop margin around bag and bench. No people, animals, train, readable signs, writing, UI, logo, watermark, border, device frame, panels or montage. Not photography, not flat anime/cel shading.
